title: Add service-backed workbook sidecar state skeleton
goal: Create the first local service and workspace-file contract for reading and writing workbook sidecar JSON state, using HVA as the proving workbook.
acceptance_criteria: A stable workspace path convention exists for workbook sidecar JSON files
Sidecar files include schema version, parent document ID, workbook ID, state payload, and audit metadata
The local service can read workbook state for a document/workbook pair
Draft state and approved state are distinguishable
The HVA prototype can consume the sidecar shape without hard-coding an Appendix A-only storage path
non_goals: Full Git commit automation for workbook state
validation: Run service smoke for workbook state endpoints or manifest reads
notes: This is the build slice implied by the sidecar-state decision. It should stay small and local-first.
